limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: non-overlapping historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded JEV-reviewed theme-level direction, magnitude, horizon, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Verified procurement and defense-industrial state changes: $2.1B Patriot sale to Ukraine, EU-Canada defense alliance/charter, FY26 MIP budget and research awards, Havelsan-Nigeria and CIEL-ASELSAN deals, Firefly Pentagon contract, base 90-day sustainment order, and US troop casualty update.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Macro state changes: US Q3 GDP beat, Taiwan 48-year-high growth, German slowdown, French contraction, Euro area unemployment, eurozone GDP, Canada stagnation, and US manufacturing PMI dip.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Material supply-side changes: Hormuz attack lifting oil, European gas surge, Eni Libyan gas deal, India oil import pivot, Russian refinery strikes and freight stress, World Bank commodity shock, Malaysia fuel repricing, and EIA structural gas/battery shifts.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Only two distinct candidates supplied; both returned. Zimbabwe exchange liquidity crisis and Morocco NPL ratio are genuine stress indicators, though local in scope.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Authoritative regulatory/legal changes and drug approvals: court striking CMS frailty rule, Ultomiris IgA nephropathy approval, VOCERYQ accelerated approval, NRx ketamine approval, Ilumya expansion, EU-Canada medical countermeasures cooperation, and Medicare premium hikes.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Ranked verified state changes with global oil/transmission relevance: Hormuz tanker attack and Saudi/Houthi exchange, Ukraine grid strikes, US-Iran war posture, EU Ukraine financing, China drone milestone, and Yemen/Sudan humanitarian conflict events.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Authoritative central-bank decisions and rate signals: ECB decisions, Bank of Canada hike, Fed hike expectations, Lagarde/ECB leadership change, BoE warning, BoJ signal, South Africa PPI, and Chile growth cut.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified shocks with transmission relevance: Israeli election deadlock, US government shutdown deal, Greece/Turkey flood warnings, Hawaii wildfire settlement, Bhutan glacial flood, Colorado preemptive power cuts, and USGS earthquakes; Spain train crash adds local shock.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Verified price state changes: gold plunge below $3,900-4,000 on oil/Hormuz shock and hawkish Fed, India gold reserve decline, energy-precious-metals rotation, Modi's gold-purchase appeal, tech-rout spillover, China offshore capital link, and silver physical weakness.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Verified market/structure signals: Intel supply-constraint selloff, Samsung 2nm hyperscaler orders, Asian AI chip demand, Indian $3B Nvidia chip raise, data-center debt risk, memory chip price cuts, robotics order peak, and New York AI-for-children ban.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified policy changes and corporate impacts: Section 338 revision on Canadian goods, China-Swiss tariff removal, EU-China retaliation warning, UK fertiliser tariff cut, India oil/tariff pivot, China-Sask canola expiry, US-Audi relief talks, and tariff-driven earnings cuts.
